title: Space owner onboarding emails get a one-click unsubscribe that works without signing in

source.ref: Email and messaging check 2026-11-18 (project thread: Check every email and message system)

detail:
The operator day 0/1/3/7 emails (lib/marketing/operator-emails.ts via operator-lifecycle.ts) are lifecycle mail but carried no List-Unsubscribe / List-Unsubscribe-Post headers, and the shared footer's link opens /settings/notifications, which needs a sign-in. Gmail and Yahoo showed no one-click button on this bulk mail, and a signed-out owner had no working way to opt out. Every other lifecycle sender (launched welcome, come-back, digest, this-week) already stamps the headers. Fix: the sender builds a signed lifecycle unsubscribe link for the owner and enqueues the email with listUnsubscribeHeaders, like launched-io.ts.

DONE 2026-11-18: headers stamped; operator-lifecycle.test.ts pins them.

verify.note: Passes while the operator emails are enqueued with one-click unsubscribe headers.
